note: The sentence-final よ is outside the chain (食べて); the card is unchanged.
教えてくれ|よ: one unit 教える, くれる is a chain piece.
行きゃがった is one chain of 行く (the END table's -ゃがる); the card is unchanged.
恐れませぬ is one chain, as 恐れません is; the card is unchanged.
飲んどる is 飲んでる in Kansai speech: one chain of 飲む.
行けよ is the godan imperative 行け and the particle; the card 行く is unchanged.
教えて欲しい is one unit; the 欲しい inside its highlight is a chain piece, not a card.
買い過ぎた is one unit of 買う; 過ぎる is a chain piece here.
言った|って話: the quoting って after a past; the card 言う is unchanged.
One space before the auxiliary: one chain of 帰る.
聞いてねえ is the negative of 聞いてる: one unit, no card for ねえ.
